# Registered HTTP operations that api/openapi.yaml does not yet describe.
#
# This file is DEBT, not policy. Every line is a real route a client cannot discover from the
# spec. TestOpenAPIRouteCoverage refuses any NEW undocumented route, so this list can only
# shrink: document an operation in openapi.yaml, then delete its line here.
#
# Regenerate the candidate list with:
#   grep -ohE '"[A-Z]+ /api/v1[^"]*"' internal/adapter/httpapi/router.go \
#     internal/adapter/httpapi/fleet_handler.go | tr -d '"' | sed -E 's/\{[a-zA-Z]+\}/{p}/g' | sort -u
#
# Path parameters are normalized to {p} so a rename does not read as a new route.
